result.justification: The objective is clearly stated as the analysis of the dynamics of SARS-CoV-2 variants in Kazakhstan, but methodological details are partially present and somewhat generic.

evidence.quote: the purpose of this study was to analyze the dynamics of the spread of SARS-CoV-2 virus variants in Kazakhstan in the period from 2020 to 2023
